Contudo ele também disse que a medida contraria a vontade soberana dos eleitores. O ex-prefeito também agradeceu aos mais de 3,7 milhões de fluminenses que votaram nele e afirmou que seu grupo político seguirá vigilante e cobrando os resultados do governo estadual. 💬 "Infelizmente, a Justiça decidiu que não haverá segundo turno, contrariando a vontade soberana dos eleitores. item.title: How a plant selfie in Colombian jungle led to ‘jaw dropping’ giant waterlily find
item.description: Species with leaves large enough to be seen from space is already critically endangered – and plans are afoot to protect it A chance social media encounter has led to the race-against-time discovery of a new species of giant waterlily that has until now been hidden in the depths of Colombia’s jungle. But the plant, which is so huge it is visible from space, is already considered critically endangered. Continue reading... Publicado también por: The Guardian - Environment. Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Brazil's Flavio Bolsonaro wins support of third-place candidate in presidential race
item.description: Brazil's right-wing presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro secured third-place finisher Augusto Cury's endorsement on Thursday, strengthening his position against incumbent President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva ahead of the runoff. item.title: Flavio Bolsonaro says he would work with China and US as Brazil’s president
item.description: Flavio Bolsonaro said he would work with the US and China if he becomes Brazil’s president, after a surprise election performance left him poised to join a wave of conservative leaders pushing Latin America closer to Washington. “I’m not going to pick sides,” Bolsonaro said at an event in Brasilia on Thursday. “My side will be the Brazilian people, whether we’re dealing with China, Israel, the Middle East, Argentina or India. It doesn’t matter. That’s how I’m going to govern.” Bolsonaro finished... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Un juez de la Corte de Brasil ordenó detener a Eduardo Bolsonaro y el hermano de Flavio reaccionó desde EE.UU. a días del balotaje
item.description: Fue sentenciado en junio pasado a cuatro años en prisión por realizar gestiones ante el gobierno de Trump en contra de la administración de Lula da Silva. El hermano del ex mandatario y del candidato presidencial vive en Texas desde 2025. Si regresa a Brasil corre riesgo de ser detenido inmediatamente. Fuente: Clarín - Mundo.

item.title: Chance Instagram sighting leads to discovery of rare giant water lily in Colombia
item.description: A new paper published in the journal Phytotaxa describes a new species in the genus Victoria, the Colombian giant water lily (Victoria colombiana). With only three other known species in the genus, V. colombiana joins the pantheon of nature's giants with pads measuring up to 2 meters (6.6 feet) across. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Delcy Rodríguez adelantó la Navidad en Venezuela: comenzará el 1 de noviembre
item.description: La mandataria anunció el inicio anticipado de esas fiestas durante una asamblea de Fedecámaras; la decisión replica una práctica que Nicolás Maduro aplicó en varias oportunidades en momentos de crisis Fuente: La Nación - El Mundo.

item.title: Netherlands report maps ecological and social aspects of large-scale carbon removal
item.description: There is a strong national and international commitment to large-scale carbon removal from the atmosphere (Carbon Dioxide Removal, CDR) to achieve climate goals. But how do you do that responsibly? A study commissioned by the Climate Research Initiative Netherlands (KIN) and led by the University of Twente shows which ecological and social effects and preconditions must be taken into account. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.description: Tras completar con éxito el histórico sobrevuelo lunar, se conoció una frase que la astronauta de la NASA pronunció mientras realizaba la misión Artemis II Fuente: La Nación - El Mundo.

item.description: Es por la derrota en la primera vuelta contra el conservador Flávio Bolsonaro. “La campaña no estuvo a la altura de mi potencial”. No hay claridad sobre la nueva estrategia para el balotaje. Fuente: Clarín - Mundo.

item.description: Turtles rescued from the Gingham Waterhole in north-west NSW have begun returning, while keepers at Taronga Western Plains Zoo in Dubbo incubate more than 250 eggs laid by females brought into care. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
